title: Chicken Hop
imageAlt: Clockwork chicken jumping between platforms in Chicken Hop artwork
seoTitle: Chicken Hop – Free Chicken Jumping Game | viggo.games
tagline: Why did the chicken hop the road? To get to the other slide!
description: Chicken Hop is a tiny browser arcade game where a brave chicken runs through a cozy house, jumps clutter, grabs corn, and tries to keep both hearts full.
metaDescription: Play Chicken Hop, a free browser arcade game on viggo.games. Jump household obstacles, collect corn, and keep a brave chicken running.
howToPlay: Choose your chicken's name and look, then start the run.
Move left or right, jump onto obstacles, and hold jump in the air to fly for up to five seconds.
Collect corn, avoid eggs and front-on collisions, and chase a new best score.
tips: Landing on top of an obstacle is safe.
Land and wait briefly to refill your flight fuel.
Use Down or S to drop through shelves and steps.

title: Hunter Guy
imageAlt: Hunter standing in a forest in Hunter Guy artwork
seoTitle: Hunter Guy – Free 3D Forest Game | viggo.games
tagline: What did the hunter say to his snack? Nice to meat you!
description: Hunter Guy is a first-person forest prototype where you walk through the woods, switch tools on a belt, and tag foxes, deer, and bears.
metaDescription: Play Hunter Guy, a free first-person browser forest game on viggo.games with simple keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
howToPlay: Start the hunt, enter the forest, and use the clearing to get your bearings.
Move and look around, then switch between the four tools on your belt.
Tag foxes, deer, and bears to build your score while they roam through the trees.
tips: Foxes and deer take one hit; bears take two.
The squirt gun scares animals without tagging them.
On touch screens, use the D-pad to move and drag the view to look around.

title: Burb
imageAlt: Futuristic rider on a neon motorcycle in Burb artwork
seoTitle: Burb – Free 3D Cycling Game Online | viggo.games
tagline: A small bird, a big road, and very serious steering.
description: Burb is a playful browser cycling game about steering a small bird along a winding 3D road.
metaDescription: Play Burb, a free browser cycling game on viggo.games. Steer a small bird through a winding 3D road.
howToPlay: Start riding and use the cockpit view to line up with the road.
Steer left or right, then speed up or slow down as the route bends.
Follow the closed road loop—or leave it and explore the low-poly landscape.
tips: Ease off the speed before a tight turn.
Touch players can use on-screen steering and speed controls.
On a supported phone, enable tilt and hold the device upright to center steering.

title: Gunny
imageAlt: Spacecraft flying over an icy canyon in Gunny artwork
seoTitle: Gunny – Free Space Shooter Game Online | viggo.games
tagline: Space is loud. Your blaster is louder.
description: Gunny is a browser space shooter where you fly past Earth and the moon, blast red ships, dodge satellites, and clear the sector.
metaDescription: Play Gunny, a free browser space shooter on viggo.games. Fly past Earth, blast raiders, and avoid satellites.
howToPlay: Launch the mission and steer your ship as it flies forward automatically.
Fire at incoming raiders while dodging their shots and drifting satellites.
Destroy 12 raiders before your hull reaches zero to clear the sector.
tips: Watch the hull, score, kills, and distance in the cockpit HUD.
Hold the mouse button or the touch fire control for continuous shots.

title: Torpedo
imageAlt: Submarine firing torpedoes in an icy underwater cavern in Torpedo artwork
seoTitle: Torpedo – Free Submarine Game Online | viggo.games
tagline: Dive deep, fire fast, and keep the hull together.
description: Torpedo is a first-person submarine browser game where you lead an underwater patrol, dodge enemy torpedoes, fire back, and step inside the submarine between combat runs.
metaDescription: Play Torpedo, a free browser submarine game on viggo.games. Dodge enemy torpedoes, fire back, and explore the submarine interior.
howToPlay: Lead the submarine formation, steer across the combat window, and line up enemies.
Fire torpedoes, dodge incoming shots, and keep your 160-point hull intact.
Open the paused submarine plan to visit rooms, use stations, and repair the engine.
tips: Use the front, port, starboard, and periscope views to track the patrol.
Giant enemy submarines fire three-torpedo salvos.
Sink five giants and collect their prizes to reach level two.
